## Engineering impact

Describe changed formulas, assumptions, constants, units, and limitations. Do not claim IEC/TSE compliance without documented review.

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, local SDK files, or signing keys included

- [ ] `UNVERIFIED_DATA` labels preserved where data is not verified
